mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_comment(board_id, member_id, parent_comment_id, content) VALUES(#{boardId}, #{memberId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{content})
mapper.sql:
c.comment_id, c.board_id, c.member_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.content, c.is_deleted AS deleted, COALESCE(lc.like_count, 0) AS like_count, c.create_at, DATE_FORMAT(c.create_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS create_at_str, COALESCE(m.nickname, '탈퇴한 회원') AS nickname, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.profile, ''), '/images/common_member.png') AS profile,
CASE WHEN c.parent_comment_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(pm.nickname, '탈퇴한 회원') ELSE NULL END AS parent_nickname

LEFT JOIN member m ON c.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN board_comment p ON c.parent_comment_id = p.comment_id LEFT JOIN member pm ON p.member_id = pm.member_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT comment_id, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM comment_like GROUP BY comment_id ) lc ON lc.comment_id = c.comment_id
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM board_comment c
WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId} AND c.is_hidden = FALSE

SELECT FROM board_comment c
WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} AND c.is_hidden = FALSE ORDER BY COALESCE(c.parent_comment_id, c.comment_id) ASC, c.create_at ASC

SELECT , b.title AS board_title FROM board_comment c
JOIN board b ON b.board_id = c.board_id WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} AND c.is_hidden = FALSE AND b.is_hidden = FALSE ORDER BY c.create_at DESC, c.comment_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment c JOIN board b ON b.board_id = c.board_id WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} AND c.is_hidden = FALSE AND b.is_hidden = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_like WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
